title: Ottawa Police Service Board - December 09, 2022
meeting_location: Andrew S. Haydon Hall, 110 Laurier Avenue West

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for participants and members of the public
agenda_items.minutes: This draft Minutes document contains a summary of the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the final Minutes. Recorded votes and dissents contained in this draft Minutes document are draft until the Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Board. The final draft Minutes will be published with the agenda for the next regular Board meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

agenda_items.title: Confirmation of Agenda
agenda_items.minutes: The Board added an in camera item to the agenda.

motions.motion_text: That the Ottawa Police Services Board confirm the amended agenda of the 9 December 2022 Special Meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

motions.motion_text: That the Ottawa Police Services Board approve the appointments of three RCMP employees listed in Document 1 as Special Constables pursuant to Section 53 of the Police Services Act, in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in the attached Approval of Appointment Forms.

sub_agendas_items.title: Appointment of Special Constables : OC Transpo

attachments.attachment_title: 2 - a- OC Transpo Appointment Sample Form .pdf

motions.motion_text: That the Ottawa Police Services Board approve the appointments of OC Transpo employees listed in Document 1 as Special Constables pursuant to Section 53 of the Police Services Act, in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in the attached Approval of Appointment forms.
